Our Dec-26 PT of NT$730 is based on 16x 2027E EPS; 16x is
more than 2-SD above the long-term average forward P/E
multiple of approximately 11x. We believe the premium is
justified given Tripod’s position as a key beneficiary under the
regular server CPU theme (Tripod has 40%+ revenue exposure
to the regular server CPU PCB market).

毛利率與營益率同步創高，核心動能來自高階產品比重提升與折舊負擔下
降，中長期則受惠高階PCB 需求成長與產品組合優化。預估健鼎(3044
TT)2026 年EPS 31.01 元，2027 年隨湖北、越南產能開出，月產能朝100
億元以上推進，支撐營收持續成長，EPS 38.48 元，建議給予本益比17 倍，
設定目標價654 元（17X＊ 2027(F)），評等「買進」。

研究部初次給予健鼎買進投資評等，主要考量：(1) CCL 自 2026 年起
多輪漲價，PCB 廠獲利普遍受到侵蝕，惟健鼎受惠高階產品占比提升及
成本轉嫁順利，2Q26 毛利率首度突破 30%，單季獲利再創新高；(2) AI
Agent 推升 CPU 需求，加上龍頭供應商產能優先配置於 AI 等高階應
用，健鼎於通用型伺服器市占率持續提升，同時伺服器平台自 2026 年
起由 PCIe Gen5 升級至 Gen6，材料規格與板層數同步提高，帶動單機
產值提升；(3) AI 伺服器帶動記憶體需求成長，伺服器 DRAM 與企業級
SSD 供需持續吃緊，預估 2026 年記憶體業務營收年增逾 50%，並與伺
服器業務形成雙成長引擎，兩者合計營收占比將由 2025 年的 55.4% 提
升至 2026 年的 68.0%、2027 年的 74.3%。研究部預估健鼎 2026 年
稅後 EPS 為 31.91 元（+64.1% YoY），2027 年進一步成長至 40.06 元
（+25.5% YoY）。此外，公司過往配息率維持六成以上，若以 2027 年獲
利及現價估算，現金殖利率約 5%，亦提供下檔保護。考量通用型伺服器
與記憶體模組雙引擎成長明確、產品組合持續優化，獲利成長具延續性，
以 2027 年稅後 EPS 給予 16 倍本益比，目標價 640 元，初次給予健
鼎買進投資評等。

因2Q26財報優預期與2H26展望上調，我們維持「增加持股」評等，上調
目標價至705元，相當於2027年預估每股盈餘的18倍本益比。

健鼎將受惠三大核心成長動能：1) 伺服器及記憶體等高毛利產品帶動產品組
合改善，已逐步反映於獲利表現；2) 原料漲價已向客戶反映價格，因此隨
2H26 營收規模放大，預期毛利率表現將延續；3) CPU Server 及Storage
需求同步增加，使DRAM 與NAND 的需求面向擴大，整體供需仍偏緊。上
調健鼎2026/2027 年獲利14.7%/15.4% ， EPS 31.05/36.46 ， 年增
59.6%/17.4%。維持健鼎本益比18 倍，以2027 年EPS 推得目標價655 元，
給予買進投資建議。

Reiterate OW, raise PT to NT$720: We are lifting our PT to NT$720 (was
NT$610) on our higher earnings forecasts plus a valuation rollover (rolling our
EPS base from 2026/27e average to 2027e). While the company may not be
considered a key supplier to any AI mainboard project anytime soon, we
believe it has executed regular server-focused very well. We believe Tripod can
continue to lift its share by leveraging its unmatched cost advantages. With
very strong earnings growth ahead (~60% in 2026e; strong double-digit %
again in 2027e) but much more rational capex spending vs. its AI peers, we find
the valuation undemanding, as the company is now trading at ~11x 2027e EPS
(JPMe). We view Tripod as a high-quality name and advise investors to
accumulate.

Lift PT to NT$610; valuation highly attractive. Our new PT is based on
higher earnings (raise 2026/27e EPS by 6/5%), and a higher multiple of 18x vs.
16x previously. We expect ~25% earnings CAGR in the coming two years.
While 18x represents the historical peak, we believe it is warranted on Tripod’s
dominating share in regular server CPU PCBs (around 40% and rising), rapid
content growth and high exposure to the regular server universe (~60%, which
is a mixture of CPU and DRAM PCBs), which makes this high quality name
a very unique proxy to the rising regular demand.

維持買進評等，目標價665元，潛在上漲空間38%：
1. 1Q26 EPS 5.61元，創同期新高。
2. 伺服器、記憶體雙驅動，估計2Q26營收季增16.9%。
3. 伺服器需求強勁，資本支出上調至百億元以上。

1Q26 GM (+1.0 ppt QoQ) missed our Citi forecast by 0.9ppt (vs in line with
consensus). However, we view +1.0ppt GM expansion as robust,
considering 1Q headwinds including RMB appreciation, continuously rising
gold price and CCL price hikes. April sales saw +12% MoM growth, boding
well for its 2Q26 momentum. The company would expand its brownfield
expansion in China, marking the beginning of a new investment cycle after
years of conservatism. Our thesis remains unchanged. We believe the
company would continue benefiting from both memory (i.e., indirect AI
demand) and CPU server uptrends. Reiterate our Buy rating with unchanged
DCF-based TP NT$666 (implied 13x 2027E EPS).

We use DCF methodology to derive our target price of NT$666. Key assumptions of our DCF model include a risk-free rate of
4.3% (10-year government bond rate), a market risk premium of 7%, and an equity beta of 0.8 (1-year weekly share price), which
derives a WACC of 9.6%. Our model assumes c.2% long-term revenue growth and gradually rising EBIT margin from 23.6% in
2027E. Our target price is equivalent to 23x/18x our 2026/27E EPS estimates and 5.6x/4.8x our 2026/27E BVPS estimates,
which we believe are more reflective of its current fundamentals.

We believe Tripod’s
main facilities are now quite occupied by strong server and DRAM demand.
Hence, we expect the company to start making efforts to reduce exposure to
low-end products, notably LCD and handsets. With better pricing and rising
scale, key products such as servers and DRAM will likely suggest Tripod to see
another year of meaningful margin expansion (say, 2ppt vs. 2025). We lift
2026/27e OP by 4/5%, and re-iterate our PT of NT$515. We view Tripod as a
great AI PCB alternative, on its “almost AI-like” earnings growth trajectory
and rational capex spending.

We raise our 2026e/2027e EPS by 7%/14% to reflect stronger demand in its server and memory
segment. Our estimates are 7%/5% above consensus. We raise our TP to TWD436
(from TWD368) based on an unchanged PE of 15x and 2H26-1H27e EPS of
TWD29.06 (from 2026e). We believe a 15x PE multiple, which is above its five-year
average but still lower than AI PCB peers, is reasonable given its ongoing margin
improvement and increasing opportunities in higher-end PCB, especially for server
CPU. With implied upside of c21%, we retain our Buy rating.

We raise our 2025/26/27E
earnings by ~1%/6%/7% to factor in AI project momentum. We also raise our DCF-
based TP by 20% to NT$600 which mainly reflects higher mid to long-term growth
prospects driven by AI. Our revised TP implies 20x 2H26-1H27E EPS which we
believe is justified by the company’s AI projects. Currently, the stock is trading on
13x/11x of our 2026/27E EPS, which we believe is undervalued vs peers’ PE of >20x
2026/27 consensus PE.

We expect 30%+ growth in both Tripod’s memory and general-purpose
server sales in 2026E, while holding a conservative view on auto and other
consumer electronics demand. We believe industry-wide unit growth, spec
upgrade and market share gain would justify Tripod’s memory/server high
growth in 2026E, as per our estimates. Despite low season in CNY, we still
expect Tripod’s 1Q26E sales to advance by 4% QoQ, followed by
continued QoQ sales growth in 2Q/3Q26E. We believe Tripod’s
conservatism in Southeast Asia expansion would prevent it from
depreciation burden vs. peers ramping capacity aggressively in SEA.
Currently, the company is trading at only 14x 2026E EPS, which is not
demanding, considering upcoming upsides from memory and general-
purpose server restocking. We raise our DCF-based TP to NT$500 (implied
19x 2026E EPS) from NT$370 (16x 2026E EPS). Reiterate Buy.

news: 今日最夯股／健鼎開盤即漲停 自營商獨買看見了什麼？

股市瞬息萬變，標的五花八門，哪一檔個股是每天市場最關注的人氣指標及話題，請看經濟日報每日精選的今日最夯股。一、股價走勢健鼎（3044）11日在追價買盤進場點火中，9點開盤第1分鐘即爆出逾600張大單，吸納市場浮動籌碼下，以漲停板520元開出，隨後在量能萎縮中，亮燈直至終場，全場上漲46.5元，成交量則減少為1,975張。二、技術面股價在10月中旬寫下604元、掛牌以來新天價後，受追價買盤縮手，陷入拉回整理格局，並在11月上旬來到395元波段新低，並跌破年線大關，隨後多頭開始反撲，迄今日K線連四紅，並站回短、中、長期均線，僅剩月線在上方處，在日KD黃金交叉、且僅在50附近，後市若量能未見失溫，將有機會挑戰600元整數大關。11日外資賣超572張，累計五天賣超5,561張；11日投信賣超44張，累計五天買超2,826張；11日自營商買超135張，累計五天買超440張。三、基本面PCB大廠健鼎10日召開董事會公布財報，2026年第3季單季每股稅後純益（EPS）為11.94元，首度單季逾一個股本，創新高，累計前三季每股稅後純益達24.95元，雙創紀錄。展望未來，健鼎已預告今年逐季成長趨勢，主要是伺服器與記憶體模組需求大幅成長與產品組合持續優化。健鼎2026年前三季合併財報營收765.15億元，較去年同期增加 40.6%。其中今年第3季合併營收約為306.94億元，季增23.48%，年增加58.3%，單季營收首度超越300億元創新高。前三季累計淨利131.17億元，年增 69.2%，前三季每股稅後稅後純益達24.96元。健鼎2026年第3季營收306.94億元，創新高，毛利率34.84%，創新高，季增 4.75 個百分點，年增 8.08 個百分點，單季稅後純益62.74億元，同步創新高，季增 61.02%%，年增1.12倍，每股純益 11.94 元。健鼎說明，今年第3季營收季增加23.48%，單季營業毛利率、營業利益率、稅前淨利率，三率三升，主要係產品組合提升，反應原材料成本提高報價，折舊比降低，致淨利突破20%創新高。健鼎10日也公布10月份合併營收約為新台幣106.37億元，受到十一長假工作天減少影響，與9月的106.48億元相比略減，但與去年同期的62.45億元相比，年成長率70.3%。健鼎累計今年前十月營收為 871.52億元，年增 43.6%。健鼎2026年上半年設備投資約71.9億元。因應市場需求，健鼎計畫，今年資本支出估可望挑戰破百億元，因應客戶群需求高速成長，至少百億元起挑為新高水準，突破過往高峰80億多元。健鼎提到，各應用產品中伺服器及記憶體相關產品需求強勁，訂單能見度持續拉長。近期PCB大廠多數朝GPU、ASIC高階AI伺服器供應，一般伺服器訂單已明顯外溢至健鼎，加上記憶體模組用板報價已逐步反應金價，二者訂單成長力道明顯優於原市場預期。
